description:
For years, National Geographic 33 changemaker Shailene Woodley has lobbied policymakers and stumped for added protections, even joining an expedition to remove floating plastics from the sea. Whether she’s on the ground or on camera, her approach appeals to people's humanity. Learn more about her efforts: https://go.natgeo.blink.app/0e67f0
